svg.title: Tic-Tac: game 1, move 1
svg.desc: Game 1 of @tannergolden against GitHub, @tannergolden plays X and GitHub O, under the Ghost Rule. Ghosts lock e5 and d2. After 1. Oe6, the Arbiter's move for GitHub: O takes the top edge of the centre board. It is @tannergolden's turn as X, in the top board, due by 7 Nov. Boards won: X 0, O 0.
